text:
elaine: Dropping a short thread about a different layout option for the SLO alert preview: a left-side "mini-map" that shows suppression indicators and channel health, and a right-side detail panel for full reasons. Mock: https://img.redwood.test/ui/minimap-preview.png. Main questions: 1) mini-map density vs discoverability (tiny badges vs small stacked rows); 2) where to put the canonical suppression copy (mini pill on the map or full sentence in the detail panel); 3) keyboard flow when toggling between map and panel.

sam: Love the idea of a mini-map for at-a-glance status, especially on dashboards. For density: use 8px badges on the map (color-only) but keep an accessible list in the panel. Map badges should have `title` attributes and be reachable via keyboard (tab to map -> arrow keys to move).

nina: Accessibility note: color-only badges on the map will be invisible to SR users unless we expose an offscreen list. I'd prefer a lightweight visible indicator on the map plus an always-present offscreen live region that describes the selected item: e.g., "1. PagerDuty: Muted until 16:30 by schedule". Also we should avoid using "Suppressed" in user-facing copy 12 it can read negative; consider "Muted" or "Paused" depending on context.

omar: UX trade: mini-map has to be clickable and keyboard navigable. If users click a badge we should expand the detail panel (sliding) with full copy. For compactness default the map to show counts: e.g., numbers for suppressed channels and a small sparkline for recent alerts. Clicking => panel opens.

elaine: Microcopy options for the panel header: A) "Muted until 16:30 (schedule)" B) "Suppressed  schedule" C) "Silenced by rota until 16:30". I worry "Silenced" feels informal. Thoughts?

sam: My vote A. Clear and time-first is helpful. For the map badges, use distinct shapes for reason type (circle = schedule, square = manual mute) + color for severity. But ensure shape difference is not the only signal  screen readers need text.

nina: Implementation a11y checklist (quick): 1) offscreen region with full sentence for selected badge (aria-live=polite) 2) map badges keyboard focusable with `aria-label` containing full reason 3) avoid color-only signals; include shape + text in panel 4) ensure 4.5:1 contrast on any text in the mini-map tooltip. I'll add tokens: use token `color-warning-700` (#b87a00) instead of `color-warning-300`.

omar: A couple of interaction notes: - map->panel should maintain focus (focus moves into panel after open) - escape closes panel and returns focus to map badge - +1 for showing truncated single-line reason on the map badge (e.g., "Muted  schedule") and full reason in panel.

elaine: Edge-case: multiple overlapping suppressions. Proposal: map shows a stacked micro-count (e.g., small stacked bars) with a numeric overlay "2" and panel shows expanded list. In the microcopy we show precedence: manual > schedule. Also include the actor if manual (e.g., "Muted by Jordan until 16:30").

sam: For SR copy prefer full sentence: "PagerDuty alerts muted until 2026-07-01 16:30 by schedule". Visually keep it short but ensure offscreen text has ISO timestamp for logs. Also recommend `aria-atomic=true` for the live region so updates are read cleanly.

elaine: Design-bot: figma updated https://www.figma.com/file/minimap/preview-v1. Action items: @nina to post the a11y checklist and exact tokens, @sam to write the keyboard/aria snippet and focus rules, @omar to prototype the mini-map interactions (click/keyboard/escape). Sync next Tues 3pm.

design-bot: Figma frame comment added: https://www.figma.com/comments/222 - mini-map prototype uploaded.

elainE: thanks all, pushing a small copy tweak afterwards (changing "Suppressed" -> "Muted" in the panel).
